paragraphs.text: The Legends Cycle is the set of storylines that took place during Legends Cycle I and Legends Cycle II . Not one continuous story per se, the Legends Cycle tells of the acts of legendary heroes of the past, of events on Jamuraa and Madara hundreds of years before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , heavily featuring legends from the Legends set. It was both set and released partially concurrently with the Weatherlight Saga , and partially overlapping in release dates with the Mirari Saga .
